items.name: Finding a Job with ACCES Employment
items.description: Interview Preparation & Personal Branding This workshop prepares participants for interviews with a focus on answering behavioral questions, articulating their strengths, and building a strong personal brand. Practical tips and examples will be shared, along with time for Q&A. Participants are encouraged (but not required) to bring a copy of their resume (digital or printed) for feedback. Drop-In. Space is limited. Room: Program Room, Basement Level No registration required.

items.name: Using AI in Job Searching and Career Exploration
items.description: Curious about how to use AI in pursuing career goals? Whether you're exploring career paths, writing a resume or preparing for interviews, this practical, interactive workshop will demonstrate how to use AI tools to support these activities. Room: Community Room, Ground Floor Registration required (27 spots remaining).

items.name: Job Search Tools
items.description: Learn about the latest tools and strategies to help you land your dream job, and the tools you can access with your library card. Room: Learning Centre 1 Registration required (7 spots remaining).

items.name: You're More Qualified Than You Think
items.description: Join one of our Career Coaches in Residence, Jermaine L Murray, for this workshop and discover the power of transferable skills. Identify valuable experience from education, retail, volunteering, caregiving and previous work. Practice translating that experience into language employers recognize. Participant takeaway: A skills inventory and three career paths to explore. Need help with Zoom? - Joining and participating in a Zoom webinar - Zoom Privacy Statement This program is part of TPL's Career Coaches in Residence and is generously supported by our lead donor Azrieli Foundation along with supporting donors Fidelity Canada, Friends of Toronto Public Library, South Chapter and William and Nona Heaslip Foundation. For more information, please visit tpl.ca/careercoach Registration required (55 spots remaining).
